//! A module of shapes.

use std::fmt;

// Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

/// A point in the plane.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Point {
    /// The horizontal position.
    pub x: i32,
    // A plain comment on a field.
    pub y: i32,
}

/// The colours a shape takes.
pub enum Color {
    /// Red.
    Red,
    Green, // a trailing comment
}

/// Shapes have an area.
pub trait Shape {
    /// The area.
    fn area(&self) -> f64;
}

impl Point {
    /// Makes a point at the origin.
    pub fn origin() -> Self {
        /// Not documentation: an item does not follow it.
        let p = Point { x: 0, y: 0 };
        p
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for Point {
    /** Writes the point. */
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.x)
    }
}

// A plain comment on a constant.
pub const LIMIT: usize = 10;

pub mod util {
    //! Helpers.

    /// Clamps a value.
    pub fn clamp(v: i32) -> i32 {
        v
    }
}
